description:
wonerujo is the WOW wallet manager for Android.
It is a lightwallet: it uses remote nodes for synchronizing to the WOW
blockchain while keeping all your private data on your device. You can run
your own node at home or connect to nodes provided by the WOW community
- it's up to you!
wonerujo is open-sourced and released
under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
Wownero is a Doge-inspired, CPU-mineable, privacy-centric memecoin. It is a
software fork of Monero with a lite version of RandomX (1MB scratchpad), a
ring size of 22, a faster difficulty adjustment, and dynamic coinbase unlock
times. Wownero has a deflationary fixed supply of 184,467,440 coins with a
slow and steady emission over 50 years. Wownero is a fairly launched coin
with no premine, instamine, stealth-mine, ICO, or dev tax.
